missing_methods.intent: Verify product is displayed in cart
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Wait for the cart items container to be visible, search for the product by product_name in the cart items list, verify that the product element is displayed and visible, and return True if found or raise an assertion error if not found.
implementation_checklist: Wait for 'cart_items_container' to be visible using wait_for(state='visible')
Locate the product heading element by role 'heading' with name matching product_name using page.get_by_role('heading', name=product_name)
Wait for the product heading element to be visible using wait_for(state='visible')
Verify the product heading element is visible using expect().to_be_visible()
Return True if all assertions pass
